The '''Batil fighter''' was a type of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] that was used by the [[Hutt Empire]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Xim Wars]]. A number of them were deployed during the [[First Battle of Vontor]].

==Behind the scenes==
Batil fighters were first mentioned in [[Xim Week: The Despotica|the first part of ''Xim Week: The Despotica'']], a series of [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] exclusive articles written by [[Michael Kogge]] and posted on [[StarWars.com]] in [[2009]]. The Batil fighter was mentioned as part of an [[in-universe]] work that described the First Battle of Vontor.<ref name="XWTD1" />
